blocks.text: The Internet & SaaS service automatically creates a profile for your organization. On the Organization page (Administration > Administration > Organization), you can review and update company information.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Administration > Organization.
On the General Information tab, click Edit to review information and make updates as needed.
The Edit General Information drawer opens.
On the Edit General Information drawer:
Company ID: The service automatically assigns your organization a Company ID. You might be asked to provide this ID when requesting Zscaler Support. This field is not editable.
Name: The service displays the organization name that you provided. This field is not editable.
Your organization name appears in the login form that the service displays:
When users authenticate to the Zscaler service.
In the user notifications, when policy violations occur.
Domains: The service displays the domains that you provided when your tenant was provisioned.
Address and Primary Time Zone: Enter the address and primary time zone for your organization. The time zones listed are those within the geographic location of your primary address.
The primary time zone is used when your organization synchronizes user, group, and department information from a directory server.
Company Logo: Click Upload to upload a logo. The service supports JPG, GIF, and PNG image files of 10 KB size or smaller.
Your company logo appears in the login form that the service displays:
When users authenticate to the Zscaler service.
In the user notifications, when policy violations occur.
See image.
Click Save.
Select the Contacts tab to review and update key contacts. Ensure that the key contacts are current so they can open Support tickets for your organization.
The Contacts page appears.
On the Contacts page:
Technical Contacts: The primary and secondary contacts listed here are authorized to open Support tickets with the Zscaler service.
Billing Contacts: The primary and secondary contacts listed here are authorized to open Support tickets with the Zscaler service.

Business Contacts: The service displays the primary contact information that you provided, and you can enter contact information for a secondary contact. You cannot edit the information for the primary contact.
See image.
Click Save and activate the change.
